Central.reason: Central Line: Minor Delays following a late finish to engineering work at White City.

DLR.reason: Docklands Light Railway: No service between Langdon Park and Poplar while we fix a faulty train at Poplar. GOOD SERVICE on all other routes.

Tram.reason: LONDON TRAMS: From Thursday 6 until Sunday 30 August, no service between Reeves Corner and East Croydon.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: No service between Brixton and Victoria while we fix a track fault at Vauxhall. SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses.

Windrush.reason: Windrush Line: No service between Surrey Quays and New Cross, and MINOR DELAYS between Highbury & Islington and West Croydon due to an unsafe structure near the railway. Good service on the rest of the line.
